Meanwhile, the Credit Card Competition Act, stalled in Congress since 2022, was just reintroduced in January 2026 with a notable new detail: a reported endorsement from President Trump. If it eventually passes, it could reshape how credit card rewards are funded.

This video breaks down exactly where all three stories stand right now, what changed, who's affected most, and the specific steps you can take today to check your own accounts — your late fee terms, your BNPL trade lines, and your rewards structure — before any of these gaps cost you money.
